payload.feature:
Decision 0038 (evidence follows content) is accepted and implemented on this branch; bring the slice to landing quality and ship it. What it holds: crates/brokkr-runtime/src/anchor.rs writes forge.journal-anchor/v3 with the merge-base and a per-file stable patch-id map beside repo_head, and refuses unknown anchor versions on --check; scripts/delivered-by-brokkr.sh is the contribution gate, run by .github/workflows/ci.yml from the trusted base, cutting vouched/docs/code tiers by the delta since the judgment, honouring Brokkr-Preflight for docs deltas and logging the tier under the by-hand label; .github/delivery-classes.json is the docs class; the workflow subscribes to labeled/unlabeled; crates/brokkr-cli/tests/decisions_index.rs derives the decision index and .gitattributes union-merges it; crates/brokkr-cli/tests/delivered_by_brokkr.rs drives the real gate over real runs; CONTRIBUTING.md, the PR template, decision 0033's erratum and the 0038 text follow.

Constraints: the exact coverage gate (scripts/coverage-exact.sh) must stay at literal 100%; clippy -D warnings and fmt must stay clean; contracts/, fixtures/ and policy/phase-machine.json are read-only; do not weaken the gate (the script and classes must come from the base branch, never the pull request); keep 0038 at Status: accepted and 0037 at proposed; do not name Looper or LaneTally in prose. The decision index must keep every row main carries, in number order.

result.notes: 0038 slice brought to landing quality on slice-evidence-follows-content. The accepted implementation (a8bf768) was verified green as it stood; two gate edges were closed in b1092d1: (1) git pairs renames by default, so a code file moved under a docs name after the judgment read as a docs delta with its deletion absent — anchor.rs and scripts/delivered-by-brokkr.sh now both diff with --no-renames, a move is a deletion plus an addition, and tests pin it (anchor: three entries after a whole-file move; gate: a move under docs/ is cut to code). (2) The docs-class check was a `jq | grep -q` pipeline whose exit status under pipefail could decide the tier; it is now one jq `all(.[]; test($docs))` ruling. Constraints held: contracts/, fixtures/, policy/phase-machine.json untouched; the gate script and classes still come from the base checkout in ci.yml; 0038 accepted, 0037 proposed; the decision index carries every main row plus 0038 in number order (test enforces); no forbidden names in the slice's prose. Nothing pushed. The landing PR cannot pass the gate it introduces (base lacks the script), so it lands under the operator's by-hand label per 0038's consequences.

Verify seat, one honest run each, no code changed. (1) `cargo test --workspace` from the worktree root: exit 0, 55 `test result: ok.` lines, 935 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored (the 935 counts four concurrent_processes child re-invocations that each report 1 passed; 1 filtered out); no FAILED/panicked/error lines in the log. Decision 0038 surfaces exercised and green: tests/delivered_by_brokkr.rs (the_gate_cuts_the_tier_by_the_delta_since_the_judgment, a_v2_anchor_vouches_for_its_head_and_nothing_else), tests/decisions_index.rs (the_index_is_exactly_the_decision_files_in_order_with_their_status, the_index_is_union_merged_so_an_appended_row_is_never_a_conflict), anchor::tests (an_unknown_anchor_version_is_refused_not_guessed, the_patch_identity_survives_a_rebase_and_names_the_file_that_changed, anchor_embeds_the_export_and_vouches_the_repository_head), corpus_parity_with_python_oracle, the_frozen_contracts_and_the_corpus_keep_their_exact_bytes. (2) `cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- compile --bundle bundles/self`: exit 0, manifest printed, bundle digest 960b99d6…411aae, engine 0.8.0, five seats (implement, intake, review, ship, verify), no lint error/warning/refusal in output. Tree clean before and after (git status empty). Logs kept under .forge/.

findings_fixed.finding: git patch-id --stable strips whitespace before hashing, so a whitespace-only edit inside a judged hunk (one space moved, a hunk re-indented) kept the vouch; a space is semantic in shell, YAML and Python. Reproduced: three variants of one hunk gave one id under --stable. Fixed: anchor.rs and scripts/delivered-by-brokkr.sh both use patch-id --verbatim; the engine feeds the diff untrimmed (git_raw) so both ids agree byte for byte; tests/delivered_by_brokkr.rs pins that one added space cuts the tier to code; 0038 ruling 1 binding names the mode and why.
ci.yml interpolated github.event.pull_request.base.ref into a run: command line. Fixed: BASE_REF/BASE_REPO reach the shell through env.

observations_info: The docs class (any *.md) covers agent-facing Markdown: seat charters under bundles/ and recipes/*/roles, CLAUDE.md, .claude skills. A post-judgment charter edit rides the docs tier. The preflight's verify+review is the same judgment a full run applies at review, so no control is lost; the class is the operator's ruling 3 and is noted, not changed.

The anchor's repo_head/base/patch are free text bound to the journal only through run_id/seq/journal_head_hash, and the journal itself is unsigned (0033: tamper-evidence, not tamper-proofing). Pre-existing trust model; 0038 adds no new exposure beyond what repo_head already had.
GitHub's own pull-request merge does not honour merge=union; ruling 5's no-conflict benefit applies to local rebases and merges, which is where the context table's conflicts arose.
Paths git quotes (non-ASCII, quotes) and git older than 2.39 (no --verbatim) make patch_identity return None, so the anchor carries patch: null and every rebase cuts to code. Fail-closed, silent.
Contributors on a fork whose origin/HEAD lags upstream get a wider base at anchor time; the exact head still vouches, a rebase cuts to code. Fail-closed.

result.notes: Reviewer seat over a8bf768..b1092d1 (decision 0038). Correctness: the slice does what the framing says and the gate test drives the real script over real runs; the v2 fallback, rename handling and the one-jq docs ruling are sound. Simplicity: the bash patch map duplicates the Rust one by necessity (the gate runs from the base); nothing dead. Security: one medium finding, fixed — the patch id ignored whitespace, so a re-indented or re-spaced hunk stayed vouched; both sides now hash verbatim and a test pins it. Discovered in the process that the engine trimmed the diff before hashing, which under --verbatim made the two sides disagree on every rebase; fixed by feeding the diff untrimmed. One low hygiene fix in ci.yml (base ref via env). Five informational observations recorded in inputs, none an open defect on this slice; the docs-class-covers-charters point is the one the operator may want to rule on later. Fix committed as 6a6a90e, tree clean; fixes_applied is true so the machine re-verifies.

Verifier seat over 6a6a90e (decision 0038, post-review fix). Step 1: `cargo test --workspace` — 55 test-result lines, every one `ok`, 935 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored, no FAILED or panicked lines anywhere in the output; the machine proof, differential corpus parity, decisions_index and delivered_by_brokkr suites are among them. Step 2: `cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- compile --bundle bundles/self` — exit 0, manifest emitted for the five seats with empty notices, bundle digest 960b99d6…411aae. Nothing changed, nothing committed.

Reviewer seat over 6a6a90e (decision 0038: anchor v3, gate script, workflow, classes, decision index, tests, prose). Read every file in the delta since 54d4311 and probed the gate against a scratch repository. Security: PR body reaches the shell only through env and a charset-restricted run id; evidence is fetched into a scratch bare repo and verified by the base branch's binary; the script and classes come from the base checkout; unknown anchor versions refuse; labels are joined by comma and matched whole — no injection, tamper or fail-open path found, severity none. Two findings, both fixed in 2eb35a5 (signed): (1) correctness/robustness, low — the per-file patch id was porcelain `git diff` over a default pathspec, so `diff.noprefix` on the anchoring machine moved every id (a clean rebase then cost a new run), `diff.external` killed the map, and a path with a leading colon, a glob character or a non-ASCII byte gave an empty or sibling-shared diff that nulled the anchor's whole map — fail-closed every time, but ruling 1 unrecorded; both sides now take `git --literal-pathspecs -c core.quotePath=false diff-tree -r --no-renames`, pinned by a runtime test and by such a page riding through the gate test's rebase. (2) correctness, medium — the by-hand label did not skip a refusal: a labelled PR naming a run with no published evidence, or one that never shipped, failed before the label was read, against 0033 ruling 5 (which 0038 ruling 6 keeps: with the label the job succeeds without evidence); the tier is now cut in a subshell whose refusal the label overrides, logged either way, pinned by two new gate assertions. Verified after the fix: cargo fmt clean, clippy -D warnings clean, cargo test --workspace 0 failures. Not run here: scripts/coverage-exact.sh (the sandbox refuses it from a seat); the production change is argument strings only, no new branch, and tests are outside the denominator, so the verifier and CI hold that gate. Info, no action: a stale local origin/main at ship widens the anchored map and costs a vouched rebase a new run (fail-closed); GitHub's web merge does not honour merge=union, so ruling 5's promise is for the operator's local rebase, which is where the conflict occurred.

Reviewer seat over 2eb35a5 (decision 0038), three dimensions. Correctness: the gate script, anchor.rs and the two new test binaries read against the rulings; the patch-id primitive was probed empirically in a scratch repo (git 2.51): a text diff keeps its id when only the index line changes (a clean rebase stays vouched), a file marked `-diff`/`binary` by .gitattributes gets a different id for a different blob (the index line is hashed for binary diffs, so a changed zip or png cannot keep a vouch), and a mode-only change carries an id of its own. The preflight branch's `from == review and next == done` is exactly REVIEW-CLEAN and REVIEW-RESIDUAL-OK in recipes/preflight/policy.json. fmt and clippy -D warnings clean at this head; the contributing, decisions_index and rename_guard binaries green after my edit. scripts/coverage-exact.sh cannot run from the seat (approval-gated); CI holds it, as the verify seat reported. Simplicity: nothing overbuilt; the v2 fallback and the by-hand subshell are the smallest shapes that hold 0033 ruling 5. Security (severity none for the change): the script and classes are read from the base checkout, event data reaches the shell only via env, run ids are regex-bound before use in refspecs and paths, evidence is fetched into a scratch bare repo, nothing from the PR checkout is built or executed, and every refusal path is fail-closed (no merge-base, no default branch, null patch map, unknown anchor version all cut to a refusal or code tier). Fix applied, one commit (a437e3f, signed): 0033 ruling 5 still prescribed closing and reopening after labelling, and the erratum written by this run said ruling 5 stands in full while 0038 ruling 4 retires exactly that step; the 0033 erratum and the 0038 consequence now say so. Observations, not findings (severity info, no action): (1) patch-id ignores hunk line numbers, so an identical hunk moved to an identical context elsewhere in the same file keeps its id — inherent to the primitive ruling 1 chose; (2) a path carrying a double quote, backslash or control byte is still quoted by --name-only under core.quotePath=false, so the engine's map goes null and the gate cuts code — fail-closed, costs a run, never a false vouch; (3) LABELS is a comma join, so a label literally containing `,by-hand,` would match, but creating or applying any label needs the same triage right as applying by-hand, so no capability is gained; (4) merge=union covers the whole decision index file, so two branches editing the same prose paragraph would concatenate silently — the ruled cost of ruling 5, guarded for table rows by the test and for prose by the operator's read of the PR diff. Tree clean after the commit.

Review seat at a437e3f (slice-evidence-follows-content); nothing changed, nothing committed, tree clean before and after. Reviewed the full delta since 54d4311 across correctness, simplicity and security. Correctness: the gate (scripts/delivered-by-brokkr.sh) and the engine (anchor.rs patch_identity) take the same diff-tree/patch-id --verbatim invocation; the gate test drives real runs through the real gate over rebase, one-space edit, docs delta, preflight, wrong-head preflight, rename, code delta, no declaration, and unpublished evidence, with and without the label; the v2 test pins that an old anchor vouches only for its head. The preflight branch requires from==review and next==done, and recipes/preflight/policy.json reaches done only by REVIEW-CLEAN (fixes_applied false) and REVIEW-RESIDUAL-OK, matching ruling 3; fixes_applied and security residuals stop. The decision index is derived (rows == files, sorted, deduped) and 0029 was moved to number order; 0037 stays proposed, 0038 accepted; no Looper/LaneTally in added prose; CONTRIBUTING's `--recipe` flag exists. fmt clean, clippy -D warnings clean (run here). Security: workflow takes verifier, script and classes from base.sha; event data reaches the shell only through env; run ids are regex-constrained before entering refspecs; delta and heads are printed as one-line compact JSON so no workflow-command line can be forged into the log; the by-hand label skips but logs the tier (ruling 6) and never turns a refusal into a silent pass without the label. Probed two edges empirically: (a) a binary or `-diff`-attributed file keeps a content-dependent id because patch-id hashes the blob oids, so the id cannot be pinned by an attribute; (b) a path containing `"`, `\` or a control character is printed quoted by --name-only and the literal lookup finds nothing — the engine then writes patch:null and the gate cuts code, i.e. fail-closed; the doc comments only claim non-ASCII names, which is accurate. Informational, no action needed: 0038 ruling 2's binding says maps are compared before heads while the script short-circuits on head equality first (same verdict); the engine measures against local origin/HEAD or main, so a stale local trunk widens the vouched map and costs a run rather than granting one. Not run here: scripts/coverage-exact.sh (refused by the seat sandbox; CI holds the gate). No findings remain; no security residual.
